text_block_list.text: Yaaawn... It seems that I am visited by a fairy of slumber.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Indeed. My rendezvous with the full
moon lasted
the whole night through.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Its wondrous white glow filtered into my
room.
Entranced, I opened my window,
and then I
sensed it.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I felt the loneliness and longing of one
who can
only visit me once in a month!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
For that pitiful moon, I recited the
heroic tales of
the Overlord until dawn.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I end the meeting early so Opera O can
get some
rest.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
